integrity: The specified probabilities and verifier are exact rational/algebraic deductions; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous closed occupancy and directly Markov observed detections, no false positives, no separate hidden local detection layer; only open parameters and ideal population-history laws. No finite-sample consistency rate or variance claim; uninspected full proof of one relevant Markov-mixture paper is a residual overlap risk.
